summary: Extraction Vision Document for Jessica Jensen, CMO of LinkedIn. Contains the Uniqueness Audit (what she brings that no existing agent covers), Business Leverage Map (deployability × differentiation), Cross-Expert Stacking Map (how her insider knowledge compounds with Lara Acosta, Diandra Escobar, Tommy Clark, and other LinkedIn-adjacent experts), and Gap Fill Analysis (the 'platform owner perspective' blind spot in the current roster). Identifies 3 extraction domains: Platform Intelligence (algorithm, feed dynamics, AI detection), B2B Brand Architecture (song sheet methodology, long-cycle trust building, LLM/GEO optimization), and Personal Brand Physics (human expression > polish, comment engagement as growth engine, creator-company brand interplay).
